boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations in College Town, the off-campus district on the Mt. Hope Avenue and Celebration Drive corridors near River Campus.

cards.title: Barnes & Noble
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Browse textbooks, apparel, gifts, and electronics at the two-level University bookstore at 1305 Mt. Hope Ave.
cards.short_summary: A bookstore stop for course materials and Rochester-branded items.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Barnes & Noble at 1305 Mt. Hope Ave. and describes it as a two-level bookstore with textbooks, apparel, gifts, and electronics.
cards.access_notes: Listed College Town hours: Mon–Fri 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sat 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Bean Cruises and Travel
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this 1335 Mt. Hope Ave. agency to ask about cruises, rail or airline tickets, lodging, and travel insurance.
cards.short_summary: A named travel-planning office on the College Town strip.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Bean Cruises and Travel at 1335 Mt. Hope Ave. and identifies its cruise, ticketing, vacation, insurance, hotel, and rental services.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon–Fri 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sat 10 a.m.–2 p.m.

cards.title: Canandaigua National Bank and Trust
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Find the regional bank branch at 1341 Mt. Hope Ave. when you need an in-person banking destination near campus.
cards.short_summary: A College Town branch of a regional Canandaigua-based bank.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Canandaigua National Bank and Trust at 1341 Mt. Hope Ave. and identifies it as a regional bank based in Canandaigua, New York.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 1333 Mt. Hope Ave. for fresh-baked cookies and milk; check the shop’s listing for its day-specific closing time.
cards.short_summary: A cookie-and-milk counter on the College Town corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Insomnia Cookies at 1333 Mt. Hope Ave. and describes fresh-baked cookies and milk.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sun noon–1 a.m.; Mon–Wed 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; Thu–Sat 11 a.m.–3 a.m.

cards.title: Joy Mart
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Browse snacks and ingredients from Japan, Korea, and elsewhere in Asia at this grocery destination at 1347 Mt. Hope Ave.
cards.short_summary: A compact grocery stop focused on Asian snacks and ingredients.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Joy Mart at 1347 Mt. Hope Ave. as a casual grocery store with snacks and ingredients from Japan, Korea, and other parts of Asia.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sun–Thu 9 a.m.–9 p.m.; Fri–Sat 9 a.m.–9:30 p.m.

cards.title: Juice Time
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit the creative juice-and-dessert shop at 1385 Mt. Hope Ave. for a nonalcoholic drink or dessert stop.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated juice-and-dessert storefront in College Town.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Juice Time at 1385 Mt. Hope Ave. and describes it as a creative juice and dessert shop.
cards.access_notes: The directory lists it as open daily from noon to midnight.

cards.title: Mala Magic
cards.subtitle: College Town — Celebration Drive corridor
cards.notes: Order a made-to-order hotpot meal at 53 Celebration Drive, the College Town destination listed for interactive hotpot dining.
cards.short_summary: A Celebration Drive restaurant centered on made-to-order hotpot.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Mala Magic at 53 Celebration Drive and describes interactive hotpot made fresh to order.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sun–Thu 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Mocha House
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Get Yemeni coffee and treats at Mocha House, listed at 1381 Mt. Hope Ave.; confirm the current schedule before going.
cards.short_summary: A coffee-and-treats stop on the Mt. Hope Avenue frontage.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Mocha House at 1381 Mt. Hope Ave. and says it serves organic Yemeni coffee and treats.
cards.access_notes: The directory posts January hours: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri–Sun 8 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Taichi Bubble Tea
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Find Taichi Bubble Tea at 1367 Mt. Hope Ave. for tea drinks with milk flavor and bubbles, as described by the directory.
cards.short_summary: A named bubble-tea counter within the College Town corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists Taichi Bubble Tea at 1367 Mt. Hope Ave. and describes tea-leaf drinks with milk flavor and bubbles.
cards.access_notes: No current hours are stated in the directory entry; verify before visiting.

cards.title: The Creator’s Hands
cards.subtitle: College Town — Mt. Hope Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Browse the 1311 Mt. Hope Ave. gallery’s arts, crafts, home décor, and gifts, all described as made in the USA.
cards.short_summary: A gallery-and-gift destination on the College Town strip.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town lists The Creator’s Hands at 1311 Mt. Hope Ave. as a gallery of USA-made arts and crafts, home décor, and gifts.
cards.access_notes: No current hours are stated in the directory entry; verify before visiting.
